description: This file defines a PHP script for rendering a subpanel view in SuiteCRM, specifically for managing prospect lists within campaigns. It sets up UI elements, including buttons and popups, and initializes a list view with templates and data.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in SuiteCRM, initialized with templates and data.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template for the list view with specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text, typically including buttons or controls.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data and view parameters.
